ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the central carbon is connected to four substituents: lower left is R, lower right is Cl, upper left is negatively charged O−, and upper right is N3. There are two curved arrows in the figure: one from the electron pair of O− pointing toward the C–O bond/central carbon direction, and another from the C–Cl bond pointing toward chlorine, indicating chlorine leaving. Reasoning: According to the arrow pushing, the lone pair electrons of O− push down to form a C=O carbonyl, while the C–Cl bond breaks to generate leaving Cl−. The R group and azide group N3 are retained on the central carbon, so the organic product skeleton is R–C(=O)–N3. Use [*] to represent the R group, and use N=[N+]=[N-] to represent the azide group, giving the SMILES: [＊]C(N=[N+]=[N-])=O. Note that the standard half-width asterisk notation is adopted finally.

method.method_draft: First inspect the image and identify the initial atom connectivity and the two curved arrows. Move the O− electron pair down to make a carbonyl C=O, simultaneously break the C–Cl bond so Cl leaves. Keep the R group and the azide group attached to the carbonyl carbon. Convert the resulting acyl azide skeleton R–C(=O)–N3 to SMILES using [*] for R and N=[N+]=[N-] for azide, giving [*]C(N=[N+]=[N-])=O.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中中心碳与四个取代基相连：左下为 R，右下为 Cl，左上为带负电的 O−，右上为 N3。图中有两条弯箭头：一条从 O− 的电子对指向 C–O 键/中心碳方向，另一条从 C–Cl 键指向氯，表示氯离去。
推理：按照箭头推动，O− 的孤对电子下推形成 C=O 羰基，同时 C–Cl 键断裂生成离去的 Cl−。中心碳上保留 R 基和叠氮基 N3，因此有机产物骨架为 R–C(=O)–N3。用 [*] 表示 R 基，用 N=[N+]=[N-] 表示叠氮基，得到 SMILES：[＊]C(N=[N+]=[N-])=O。注意最终采用标准半角星号写法。

method.method_draft: Classify the depicted species as the tetrahedral intermediate from acyl substitution, with O− as the carbonyl oxygen precursor, Cl as leaving group, and N3 as the substituent that stays bonded to the acyl carbon. Collapse the intermediate according to the acyl-substitution pattern: regenerate C=O and remove Cl. Write the final organic molecule as an acyl azide, R–C(=O)–N3, then translate to the requested SMILES: [*]C(N=[N+]=[N-])=O.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中是一个酰基取代的四面体中间体，中心碳连接四个基团：左下为 R 基，左上为带负电的氧 O⁻，右上为 N3 基团，右下为 Cl。弯箭头显示 O⁻ 的电子回到中心碳形成 C=O，同时 C–Cl 键电子转移到 Cl，使 Cl 离去。
再推理：按照酰基取代中间体的坍塌模式，带负电的氧重新形成羰基，氯作为离去基被移除，而 N3 保持与酰基碳相连。因此产物的有机部分为酰基叠氮化物 R–C(=O)–N3。用通配符 [*] 表示 R 基，并将叠氮基写成 N=[N+]=[N-]，对应 SMILES 为 [*]C(N=[N+]=[N-])=O。
